notes: Resident population from the 2024 Iraqi census by qadaa (district) — unlike Baghdad, Erbil city itself is NOT subdivided in this data: "Markaz Erbil" (Erbil Center) qadaa covers the whole city as a single unit, with three separate qadaas (Khabat, Erbil Plain, Qushtapa) covering surrounding rural/satellite areas outside the city proper. Districts only partially inside the map's bounding box are linearly prorated by area fraction. No real employment data exists: jobs are a flat 40% of resident population, redistributed across OSM buildings weighted by floor area only. Commute flows are an unconstrained gravity model with no real O/D anchor of any kind.
sources: https://www.citypopulation.de/en/iraq/cities/ (aggregator citing Iraq's official "Census 2024-11-25" by qadha — no direct COSIT/KRSO table with this breakdown was found; disclosed as a secondary source, not primary)
